Heroku deploy via git push. Steps:

```bash
heroku login                          # auth browser
heroku git:remote -a <app-name>       # link existing app (or: heroku create <name>)
git push heroku v2026:main            # push current branch to heroku main
```

Key points:
- Heroku deploy = push to `heroku` remote. Build trigger on push to `main`/`master` branch heroku-side.
- You on branch `v2026`. Map it: `git push heroku v2026:main`.
- First time: `heroku create <name>` make app + remote. Existing app: `heroku git:remote -a <name>`.

Useful after:
```bash
heroku logs --tail        # watch build/runtime logs
heroku open               # open in browser
heroku ps                 # dyno status
heroku config:set KEY=val # env vars
```

Next.js note: need `start` script bind `$PORT`. Heroku set `PORT` env. Verify `package.json`:
```json
"start": "next start -p $PORT"
```
